semantics.summary: Returns a random 16-bit integer in the range from 0 to y-1; the 3.5 addendum example uses RAND(10) as a matrix element value.

printed-pages: Base-manual function definition, printed pp. 4-17–4-18 (3.0-origin semantics only)
notes: The 3.5 example directly demonstrates the one-argument RAND(10) form. The result range and 16-bit description come from the 3.0 base-manual definition; distribution, seed behavior, and other random functions are not reconfirmed by this occurrence.
